query: Plan and prototype a network participation wizard.
expected_behavior: Enters Plan + Prototype mode and produces a Solution Plan and a single-file HTML prototype, with no Given/When/Then and no Pattern E
States once that no capability is bound and asks grouped, numbered free-text discovery questions covering at least D-1, D-4, D-5, D-8, D-10 and D-11
Records archetype Unknown and labels every unresolved dimension [Assumed — confirm], each with a matching Clarification Question
Uses product objects (HealthcareFacilityNetwork, HealthcarePractitionerFacility, HealthcarePayerNetwork) labelled [Product] or [Assumed — confirm], never as discovered facts
Prototype carries the SLDS 2 :root token block, a build-technology banner, a component legend and a badge on every interactive or data-bearing element
Prototype self-check comment records 'passed: X / 10' honestly
Shows status values as '{status per D-5}' placeholders
Includes an Estimated Effort table marked AI-estimated
must_not: Pick an archetype, prefix, status model or stage sequence by default
Use a hard-coded pixel font size in the prototype
Leave any custom element without a provenance label
